## Summary

Elmhurst Clinics LLP (policy CC-1666): fire damage in a neighbouring unit to a label printer and a barcode scanner at a storage unit on Mill Road. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 3,254 dollars.

## Facts

Elmhurst Clinics LLP reported the loss on 21 June 2026 under policy CC-1666 [notice of loss]. The loss was fire damage in a neighbouring unit [notice of loss], [incident report]. It occurred at a storage unit on Mill Road [notice of loss]. The items are a label printer and a barcode scanner [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 23 June 2026 under reference IR/2026/4234 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. The label printer was invoiced at 1,666 dollars by Beacon Office Supply [invoice 1]. The barcode scanner was invoiced at 1,588 dollars by Crane & Sons Electronics [invoice 2].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the premises named in the schedule, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft, fire, storm or escape of water [policy]. Fire is a named cause [policy]. The items were business contents kept at the storage unit [notice of loss], [incident report].

The policy schedule is not in the file, and no document states in terms that the storage unit is a scheduled premises or that the items were in the insured's custody there. This conclusion rests on the items having been kept at the storage unit [notice of loss], [incident report]. The schedule should be checked to confirm the premises.

Each exclusion has been considered:
- Exclusion 7.1 does not apply. It concerns theft of unattended portable equipment, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.3 does not apply. It concerns gradual deterioration, and the loss is fire damage [notice of loss], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.5 does not apply. It operates only where theft is alleged, and none is [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to the schedule check noted above.

## Reserve

The reserve is 3,254 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (1,666 dollars and 1,588 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 deducts the 250 dollar excess only where the schedule applies one, and where no excess is shown none applies [policy]. No schedule is in the file, so no excess is deducted. If the schedule shows an excess, the reserve becomes 3,004 dollars.
